model_call: The model runs only in the host (mcp_agent.py calls rag.complete_chat) after tools/list, when it chooses a tool. initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, and tools/call do not call a model; the ingredient-db server only reads its table.

annotations.jsonrpc: Protocol marker. Must be the string 2.0. Not a tool and not a model.
annotations.method: Handshake method name. The server replies with its own capabilities. No tool runs.
annotations.params: What the client is. protocolVersion is the MCP revision both sides agree on. capabilities is empty because this client only consumes tools. clientInfo names the host.
annotations.id: Request id. The matching response must carry the same id. A notification has no id.

annotations.jsonrpc: Same protocol marker on the response.
annotations.id: Echo of request 1, so the host knows this body answers initialize.
annotations.result: Success payload. protocolVersion agrees. capabilities says this server has tools and resources, and the tool list will not change mid-session. serverInfo.name is ingredient-db, the second server. There is no error field because the handshake succeeded.

annotations.method: Tells the server the client finished the handshake. The server must not reply.
annotations.id: Absent on purpose. No id means no response, so this message cannot be a tool result or a model reply.
annotations.params: Absent. This notification carries no arguments.

annotations.method: Discovery. The host asks what tools exist. It does not send a tool name, because it does not know them yet.
annotations.id: Request id 2. The tool catalogue comes back with this id.
annotations.params: Absent. tools/list takes no arguments on this server.

tools.name: lookup_allergen
tools.description: Look up allergen flags for one ingredient name. Input: {"ingredient": "butter"}. If the text says try another spelling, call lookup_allergen again with that name. Do not invent allergen flags.

tools.name: lookup_nutrition
tools.description: Look up per-100g nutrition for one ingredient name. Input: {"ingredient": "butter"}. If the token cannot read nutrition, say so and do not invent numbers.

annotations.result: The discovered tools. Only lookup_allergen and lookup_nutrition. The allergen matrix is not in this list; it is a resource the host reads separately. These names are what the agent prompt is built from.

annotations.method: Invoke one discovered tool. This is still the host talking to the server, not a model call.
annotations.params: name is lookup_allergen, taken from tools/list. arguments.ingredient is the value the model chose after it saw the tool description.
annotations.id: Request id 3. The tool result comes back with this id.

annotations.result: Tool output. content[0].text is the table row for butter (allergen milk). isError false means the name matched. The server did not generate this sentence with a model.
annotations.error: Absent. A JSON-RPC error object would mean the call itself failed (bad method, bad params). A missed ingredient is a tool result with isError true, not this field.
